description: CLK2 (carrier about 145 MHz, 3rd harmonic wanted) through 12 cm of pigtail, an unidentified SAW filter, the 27-33-27 ohm T pad and the BNC attenuator marked 10 dB

chain.name: 12 cm pigtail from the Si5351 board to the SAW filter
chain.notes: the same pigtail as used on 2m and 6m; type not recorded

chain.name: SAW filter
chain.notes: wide passband, about 421-444 MHz at -3 dB (measured 2026-10-31)

chain.name: attenuator
chain.notes: in front of the analyser; marked 10 dB, measured 25.8 dB at 435 MHz

chain.name: 27-33-27 ohm T pad
chain.notes: loses only 9.9 dB at 435 MHz (15 dB at 145 MHz; the carbon resistors are not flat to UHF). Measured in place on 2026-11-01 as the drop in level after fitting it, at 2, 4, 6 and 8 mA (9.84 to 10.0 dB), with the pigtail, SAW and attenuator in line.

notes: Compare with 70cm-saw-unknown-10dB (SAW directly on the board, no pad) and 70cm-saw-unknown-10dB-12cm-pigtail (setup only; the run was refused, the signal being 6 dB too strong). With the 12 cm pigtail the 435 MHz level rose by 6 to 10 dB (measured 2026-11-01), so the T pad was added. Total pad 35.7 dB (25.8 + 9.9, about +/-0.3 dB). Levels leaving the SAW are therefore comparable with the baseline only at the dBc level, not in dBm: the pigtail changes the output level.
